description: British Geological Survey data (OpenGeoscience and licensed data) is a hazard data portal run by British Geological Survey (BGS). The data page describes over 400 datasets in the survey's care: geological, offshore, ground stability and 3D models, map viewers, borehole collections, scanned records, applications and online services, with free downloads of maps and scans through OpenGeoscience. Coverage: United Kingdom and offshore. Part of the data is free of charge and part is paid or licensed on request. The licence is: mixed: free downloads through OpenGeoscience, licensed geoscience data, Open Government Licence and other licences. Caveats: part of the data is licensed and paid, and the page does not list the individual datasets, so ground-stability layers must be picked from the sub-pages. It can support ground stability and geohazard inputs for UK infrastructure studies. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet; the data are reached through the portal page linked here. This record was written from the primary page fetched on 2026-09-30: page text read; the data themselves were not downloaded.
